records.derivation: Used only to show that multiple game processes can share a VM and that idle capacity exists. The calculator's 1 Wh server-IT central allowance remains project synthesis rather than a PlayFab or Activision result.
limitations: There is no evidence that Call of Duty uses PlayFab.
No host power, utilization, server density, or per-player energy is reported.
This source cannot independently validate the 1 Wh server-IT coefficient.
